grammar: n. 预测；预言。动词为 predict，常见词形 prediction(s)。
collocations: make a prediction; a prediction about the future; predict that ...
commonMistake: prediction 是名词，predict 是动词；不要说 make a predict。

example.english: Her prediction about future transport was quite positive.
example.chinese: 她对未来交通的预测相当乐观。

application.prompt: The report is a ___ about life in 2050. A. prediction B. passenger
application.solution: A。解析：about life in 2050 的预测用名词 prediction。

grammar: adj. 外面的；外表的；位于外部的。可作定语，outermost 表示最外层的。
collocations: the outer wall; the outer layer; outer space
commonMistake: outer 表示“外部的”，不等于 other（其他的）；outer 通常不单独作表语。

example.english: The outer wall of the science centre is made of glass.
example.chinese: 科学中心的外墙是玻璃做的。

application.prompt: The layer farthest from the centre is the ___ layer. A. inner B. outer
application.solution: B。解析：outer 与 farthest from the centre 对应，表示外面的。

grammar: n. 太空；外层空间，通常作不可数名词。常用 in outer space。
collocations: explore outer space; travel in outer space; outer space research
commonMistake: outer space 通常不加 a；表示“在太空中”说 in outer space。

example.english: The new spacecraft may travel through outer space one day.
example.chinese: 新型航天器有一天可能会穿越外层空间。

application.prompt: Astronauts work ___ for months at a time. A. in outer space B. at the outer space
application.solution: A。解析：表示“在太空中”用 in outer space，且 space 此处不加冠词。

grammar: adj./adv. 更差的；更糟的，是 bad 和 badly 的比较级；最高级为 worst。
collocations: get worse; feel worse; worse than before
commonMistake: worse 是比较级，后常接 than；最高级用 worst，不要写 worsest。

example.english: The traffic is worse today than it was yesterday.
example.chinese: 今天的交通比昨天更糟。

application.prompt: The weather became ___ after the storm. A. worse B. worst
application.solution: A。解析：这里没有最高级范围提示，表示情况变得更糟，用比较级 worse。

grammar: phr. 接替；接管；接收。可接名词作宾语，也可表示接管某职位或职责。
collocations: take over a company; take over a job; take over responsibility for ...
commonMistake: take over 的宾语可放在 over 后；代词通常放中间：take it over。

example.english: A new team will take over the project next month.
example.chinese: 一个新团队下个月将接手这个项目。

application.prompt: The old manager is leaving, so Mia will ___ the team. A. take over B. take after
application.solution: A。解析：接替负责人、接管团队用 take over；take after 表示长得像或性格像。

grammar: n. 科幻小说（或影片等）；science fiction 的非正式缩略形式，也可作名词前置修饰语。
collocations: sci-fi film; sci-fi story; read sci-fi
commonMistake: sci-fi 是 science fiction 的缩写，拼写常带连字符；不要误拼成 sci fi。

example.english: We watched a sci-fi film about robots and space travel.
example.chinese: 我们看了一部关于机器人和太空旅行的科幻电影。

application.prompt: A story about robots in the future is often a ___ story. A. sci-fi B. history
application.solution: A。解析：机器人与未来题材的故事属于 sci-fi（科幻）作品。

grammar: n. 票；券，可数，复数 tickets。常用 ticket to/for。
collocations: buy a ticket; a ticket to the concert; train ticket
commonMistake: ticket 是可数名词，单数前通常要用 a/an；不要漏冠词。

example.english: I bought two tickets for Saturday's concert.
example.chinese: 我买了两张星期六音乐会的票。

application.prompt: You need a ___ to enter the concert hall. A. wallet B. ticket
application.solution: B。解析：进入音乐厅需要票，用 ticket。

grammar: adj. 乐观的；积极的；良好的。常用于 be positive about sth，也可修饰 effect/result。
collocations: a positive attitude; positive about the future; a positive effect
commonMistake: positive 可表示“积极的、乐观的”，也可表示“确信的”，如 be positive that...；需根据语境判断。

example.english: She stays positive about the future of clean transport.
example.chinese: 她对清洁交通的未来保持乐观。

application.prompt: Although the task is hard, Leo remains ___ and keeps trying. A. positive B. careless
application.solution: A。解析：遇到困难仍坚持尝试，说明态度积极，用 positive。

grammar: n. 交通；运输，通常不可数；v. 进行非法交易（教材语境以交通为主）。
collocations: heavy traffic; traffic lights; a traffic jam
commonMistake: traffic 表示“交通”时通常不可数，不说 a traffic；“交通拥堵”可说 heavy traffic 或 a traffic jam。

example.english: There is heavy traffic near the station every morning.
example.chinese: 每天早晨车站附近交通都很拥堵。

application.prompt: There is ___ on the road after the concert. A. many traffics B. heavy traffic
application.solution: B。解析：traffic 作“交通”讲通常不可数，用 heavy 修饰。

grammar: n. 科技；工艺，通常不可数；特定技术可用 technologies。
collocations: modern technology; technology in education; use technology
commonMistake: technology 通常不可数；指具体多种技术时才可用复数 technologies。

example.english: Modern technology helps people share information quickly.
example.chinese: 现代科技帮助人们快速分享信息。

application.prompt: ___ has changed the way students learn. A. Technology B. A technology
application.solution: A。解析：泛指科技时 technology 通常作不可数名词，不加 a。

grammar: n. 视频；录像系统；v. 录像，过去式/过去分词为 videoed 或 videotaped（常用表达）。
collocations: watch a video; a video call; video an event
commonMistake: video 作名词表示一个视频时是可数名词；作动词时用 video sth，不要把名词和动词用法混淆。

example.english: Our class made a short video about future schools.
example.chinese: 我们班制作了一段关于未来学校的短视频。

application.prompt: We watched a short ___ about smart cities in class. A. traffic B. video
application.solution: B。解析：观看的一段影像是 video（视频）。

grammar: n. 交通运输系统；旅行方式；v. 运输、运送。英式英语中作名词表示公共交通时常为不可数。
collocations: public transport; transport goods; a means of transport
commonMistake: transport 可作名词或动词；说“运输某物”直接用 transport goods，不加 to。

example.english: Electric buses transport passengers across the city.
example.chinese: 电动公交车把乘客运送到城市各处。

application.prompt: Trucks ___ food to the shops every morning. A. predict B. transport
application.solution: B。解析：卡车把食品运送到商店，用动词 transport。

grammar: n. 系统；制度；体系，可数，复数 systems。
collocations: a transport system; a computer system; the school system
commonMistake: system 是可数名词，单数通常要有冠词或限定词，如 a system。

example.english: The city is building a better transport system.
example.chinese: 这座城市正在建设更完善的交通系统。

application.prompt: A group of connected parts working together is a ___. A. system B. ticket
application.solution: A。解析：由相互关联部分构成并共同运作的体系是 system。

grammar: adj. 效率高的；有功效的。副词 efficiently，名词 efficiency。
collocations: an efficient system; work efficiently; energy-efficient buses
commonMistake: efficient 是形容词，修饰名词；副词形式为 efficiently，不能用 efficient 修饰动词。

example.english: The new train system is faster and more efficient.
example.chinese: 新的列车系统更快，效率也更高。

application.prompt: The new machine uses less energy and works more ___. A. efficient B. efficiently
application.solution: B。解析：修饰动词 works 要用副词 efficiently。

grammar: n. 教育，通常不可数；形容词为 educational。
collocations: receive an education; the education system; education for all
commonMistake: education 泛指教育时通常不可数；修饰名词的形容词是 educational。

example.english: Technology can support education in many different ways.
example.chinese: 科技可以通过许多不同的方式支持教育。

application.prompt: Every child should have access to good ___. A. educations B. education
application.solution: B。解析：泛指教育时 education 通常不可数。

grammar: n. 长度；时长，可数。形容词 long；常用 the length of。
collocations: the length of a film; a length of 2 metres; at length
commonMistake: length 表示长度或时长；描述物体“有多长”也可用 be ... long，不要说 be ... length。

example.english: The length of the video is about ten minutes.
example.chinese: 这段视频的时长大约是十分钟。

application.prompt: The ___ of the lesson is 40 minutes. A. long B. length
application.solution: B。解析：空格前有 the，需名词 length；long 是形容词。

grammar: n. 话题；题目；标题，可数。
collocations: a topic for discussion; talk about a topic; change the topic
commonMistake: topic 是讨论内容；title 指作品的标题，不要把二者当作同义词。

example.english: Robots are an interesting topic for our class discussion.
example.chinese: 机器人是我们班级讨论的一个有趣话题。

application.prompt: The students chose robots as the ___ of their discussion. A. partner B. topic
application.solution: B。解析：讨论的内容是 topic（话题）。

grammar: n. 搭档；同伴；合伙人，可数。
collocations: a learning partner; work with a partner; business partner
commonMistake: partner 指一起合作的人；表示“两人一组”常说 work in pairs 或 work with a partner。

example.english: Please work with a partner to plan the future city.
example.chinese: 请和一位搭档一起规划未来城市。

application.prompt: The teacher asked each student to work with a ___. A. partner B. traffic
application.solution: A。解析：两人合作时，另一人是 partner（搭档）。

grammar: modal v. 将要；将会。现代英语中常用于 I/we shall，或 Shall we ...? 提建议、征求意见；多用 will 表将来。
collocations: Shall we ...?; I shall return; We shall see
commonMistake: shall 后接动词原形；提建议时用 Shall we + 动词原形，不加 to。

example.english: Shall we use clean energy in our model city?
example.chinese: 我们在城市模型中使用清洁能源好吗？

application.prompt: ___ we start the presentation now? A. Are B. Shall
application.solution: B。解析：用 Shall we ...? 礼貌地提出建议。

grammar: v. 及格；通过；经过；传递；n. 及格；通行证。过去式/过去分词 passed。
collocations: pass an exam; pass a test; pass a message to sb
commonMistake: pass 是动词时过去式加 -ed：passed；pass an exam 表示通过考试，pass sb sth 表示递给某人某物。

example.english: Mia passed the science test on her first try.
example.chinese: 米娅第一次就通过了科学测验。

application.prompt: Sam studied hard and ___ the final exam. A. passed B. past
application.solution: A。解析：句中需要动词“通过”，用 pass 的过去式 passed；past 常作介词或形容词。

grammar: n. 优胜者；获胜者；成功者，可数。动词为 win，过去式 won。
collocations: the winner of a contest; prize winner; a clear winner
commonMistake: winner 是“获胜者”名词；win 是动词，不要说 He is a win。

example.english: The winner of the school science contest was announced today.
example.chinese: 学校科学竞赛的获胜者今天公布了。

application.prompt: The person who wins the contest is the ___. A. researcher B. winner
application.solution: B。解析：获胜的人叫 winner；win 是“获胜”这个动作。

grammar: n. 治疗方法；疗法；v. 治愈、治好。
collocations: a cure for a disease; cure a patient; cure sb of an illness
commonMistake: cure 可作名词或动词；常说 a cure for ...，不要误用 cure of 代替名词结构。

example.english: Researchers are working to find a cure for the disease.
example.chinese: 研究人员正在努力寻找这种疾病的疗法。

application.prompt: Scientists hope to find ___ for the illness. A. a concert B. a cure
application.solution: B。解析：治疗疾病的方法是 a cure for the illness。

grammar: n. 癌症，通常作不可数名词；具体类型可说 lung cancer 等。
collocations: cancer research; a cancer patient; lung cancer
commonMistake: 表示疾病“癌症”时通常不加 a；可说 a cancer patient（癌症患者）。

example.english: The hospital supports cancer research and patient care.
example.chinese: 这家医院支持癌症研究和患者护理。

application.prompt: Doctors are studying ways to treat ___. A. cash B. cancer
application.solution: B。解析：治疗与研究的疾病是 cancer。

grammar: n. 音乐会；演奏会，可数。
collocations: go to a concert; give a concert; a concert hall
commonMistake: 表示去听音乐会常说 go to a concert；concert 是可数名词，单数前用 a。

example.english: Our school band will give a concert this Friday.
example.chinese: 我们学校乐队将在本周五举办一场音乐会。

application.prompt: The school band is playing live music at a ___. A. system B. concert
application.solution: B。解析：现场演奏音乐的活动是 concert（音乐会）。

grammar: n. 现金；钱，通常不可数；v. 兑现支票等。
collocations: pay in cash; cash payment; cash a cheque
commonMistake: cash 作“现金”讲通常不可数，不说 a cash；“用现金支付”说 pay in cash。

example.english: You can pay for the ticket in cash or by card.
example.chinese: 你可以用现金或银行卡支付门票。

application.prompt: We paid for lunch ___ because the card machine was broken. A. in cash B. in wallet
application.solution: A。解析：表示“用现金支付”用 in cash。

grammar: n. 钱包；皮夹，可数。
collocations: a leather wallet; keep cash in a wallet; lose one's wallet
commonMistake: wallet 是可数名词；英式英语中女性的小钱包常称 purse，注意语境与地区差别。

example.english: He put the ticket safely in his wallet.
example.chinese: 他把票妥善地放进了钱包里。

application.prompt: He keeps his money and cards in a ___. A. wallet B. disaster
application.solution: A。解析：装钱和卡片的钱包是 wallet。

grammar: n. 客人；宾客，可数。
collocations: welcome a guest; guest speaker; house guest
commonMistake: guest 是受邀来的客人；host 是主人，二者身份相反。

example.english: The guest speaker talked about robotics and education.
example.chinese: 特邀演讲嘉宾谈了机器人学和教育。

application.prompt: The person invited to stay or attend an event is a ___. A. guest B. host
application.solution: A。解析：被邀请来的人是 guest；接待客人的人是 host。

grammar: adj. 首席的；最重要的；n. 首领、负责人。
collocations: chief reason; chief scientist; the chief of a team
commonMistake: chief 可作形容词或名词；不要与 chef（厨师）混淆拼写和词义。

example.english: The chief scientist explained how the robot works.
example.chinese: 首席科学家解释了机器人如何工作。

application.prompt: The ___ scientist led the research team. A. chief B. cheap
application.solution: A。解析：chief scientist 表示首席科学家；cheap 意为便宜的。

grammar: n. 研究者；探索者，可数。动词 research；research 作“研究”通常不可数。
collocations: a medical researcher; a team of researchers; conduct research
commonMistake: researcher 指做研究的人；research 多作不可数名词，不说 a research 表示一项研究。

example.english: A researcher is testing a new way to save energy.
example.chinese: 一位研究人员正在测试一种新的节能方法。

application.prompt: The ___ collected information about the new transport system. A. winner B. researcher
application.solution: B。解析：收集研究资料的人是 researcher。

grammar: adv. 到处；所有地方；也可作代词性用法。
collocations: look everywhere; everywhere else; be seen everywhere
commonMistake: everywhere 本身已含“在各处”之意，通常不与 to 连用；不说 go to everywhere。

example.english: Smart devices are becoming common everywhere.
example.chinese: 智能设备正在各地变得普遍。

application.prompt: We looked ___ for the missing ticket. A. to everywhere B. everywhere
application.solution: B。解析：everywhere 作副词时前面不加 to。

grammar: n. 机器人学，学科名称，通常不可数。
collocations: study robotics; robotics industry; robotics engineer
commonMistake: robotics 是学科名，通常不可数；表示机器人本身用 robots，不要混用。

example.english: My sister wants to study robotics at university.
example.chinese: 我姐姐想在大学学习机器人学。

application.prompt: The science club will learn about the design of robots in its ___ class. A. robotics B. traffic
application.solution: A。解析：研究机器人设计的学科是 robotics。

grammar: n. 行业；工业，可数；industrial 为形容词。
collocations: the technology industry; heavy industry; industry standards
commonMistake: industry 是名词；形容词“工业的”是 industrial，不要把两种词性混用。

example.english: Robotics is changing the transport industry.
example.chinese: 机器人技术正在改变交通运输行业。

application.prompt: Factories and businesses in a particular field form an ___. A. education B. industry
application.solution: B。解析：同一领域的工厂和企业构成一个 industry（行业）。

grammar: n. 服务；公共服务，可数或不可数，按具体服务种类可用复数 services。
collocations: public services; customer service; provide a service
commonMistake: service 可指服务行为或具体服务；服务项目可用复数 services，不要一概当作不可数。

example.english: The city provides a free bus service for older people.
example.chinese: 这座城市为老年人提供免费公交服务。

application.prompt: The city offers useful public ___ to its residents. A. services B. traffics
application.solution: A。解析：公共服务项目常用复数 services；traffic 通常不可数。

grammar: n. 灾难；不幸，可数。形容词 disastrous。
collocations: a natural disaster; disaster area; a major disaster
commonMistake: disaster 是名词，形容词是 disastrous；不要把 disaster 当作形容词修饰名词。

example.english: The robot helped people after the natural disaster.
example.chinese: 自然灾害发生后，机器人帮助了人们。

application.prompt: An earthquake can be a serious natural ___. A. emergency exit B. disaster
application.solution: B。解析：地震属于自然灾害 natural disaster。

grammar: n. 突发事件；紧急情况，可数。
collocations: in an emergency; emergency services; emergency exit
commonMistake: emergency 是可数名词，常说 in an emergency；不要漏掉 an。

example.english: In an emergency, call the local rescue service.
example.chinese: 遇到紧急情况，请拨打当地救援服务电话。

application.prompt: If there is a fire, use the ___ exit. A. emergency B. emotional
application.solution: A。解析：紧急出口称 emergency exit。

grammar: v. 消失；不见。过去式/过去分词 disappeared，名词 disappearance。
collocations: disappear suddenly; disappear from sight; disappear into the distance
commonMistake: disappear 是动词，过去式双写 p 再加 -ed：disappeared；不要漏写一个 p。

example.english: The small robot disappeared behind the door.
example.chinese: 小机器人消失在门后。

application.prompt: The lights went out, and the little robot ___ from sight. A. disappeared B. disappear
application.solution: A。解析：叙述过去发生的事用 disappeared。

grammar: adj. 挑战性的；需要努力的。动词 challenge，名词 challenge。
collocations: a challenging task; find sth challenging; challenging to do
commonMistake: challenging 描述“具有挑战性”；challenged 常表示受到挑战或有某种障碍，不能随意替换。

example.english: Learning to build a robot can be challenging but fun.
example.chinese: 学习制作机器人可能很有挑战性，但也很有趣。

application.prompt: The problem is difficult and needs careful thought. It is ___. A. valuable B. challenging
application.solution: B。解析：困难且需要努力的事是 challenging（有挑战性的）。

grammar: n. 飞行员；领航员，可数；也可作动词表示驾驶（飞行器）或试行。
collocations: a test pilot; become a pilot; pilot a plane
commonMistake: pilot 作职业名词时可数，单数前用 a；pilot a plane 中作动词，后直接接宾语。

example.english: The pilot landed the plane safely in bad weather.
example.chinese: 飞行员在恶劣天气中安全地降落了飞机。

application.prompt: The person who flies an aircraft is a ___. A. passenger B. pilot
application.solution: B。解析：驾驶飞机的人是 pilot；passenger 是乘客。

grammar: n. 专家；行家，可数；adj. 熟练的；内行的。常用 expert in/on。
collocations: an expert in robotics; expert advice; be expert at doing sth
commonMistake: expert 作名词时单数前要用 an；表示擅长某领域常用 expert in/on。

example.english: We asked an expert in robotics to answer our questions.
example.chinese: 我们请了一位机器人学专家回答问题。

application.prompt: Someone with special knowledge of robotics is an ___. A. expert B. guest
application.solution: A。解析：在某领域有专业知识的人是 expert。

grammar: v. 代替；取代；替换。过去式/过去分词 replaced。常用 replace A with B。
collocations: replace an old machine; replace A with B; replace a worker
commonMistake: “用 B 替换 A”说 replace A with B；不要用 replace by 来表达主动结构。

example.english: The school replaced old lights with energy-saving ones.
example.chinese: 学校用节能灯替换了旧灯。

application.prompt: The new battery will ___ the one that no longer works. A. replace B. depend
application.solution: A。解析：用新的电池替换坏电池用 replace。

grammar: n. 创造力，通常不可数。形容词 creative；动词 create。
collocations: show creativity; encourage creativity; creative thinking
commonMistake: creativity 是不可数名词；表示“有创造力的”用 creative，不要说 creativity idea。

example.english: Robotics projects can encourage creativity in students.
example.chinese: 机器人项目可以培养学生的创造力。

application.prompt: Art and design activities help children develop ___. A. creative B. creativity
application.solution: B。解析：空格作动词 develop 的宾语，需要名词 creativity。

grammar: adj. 情感的；情绪的。名词 emotion；常见复合词 emotional intelligence。
collocations: emotional support; emotional health; emotional intelligence
commonMistake: emotional 是形容词，emotion 是名词；说“情绪”不要把 emotional 当名词。

example.english: Robots may help people, but they cannot replace emotional support from friends.
example.chinese: 机器人或许能帮助人们，但不能取代朋友给予的情感支持。

application.prompt: A person's ___ needs include feeling understood and supported. A. emotional B. emotion
application.solution: A。解析：修饰名词 needs 用形容词 emotional。

grammar: n. 智力；智慧，通常不可数；形容词 intelligent。
collocations: artificial intelligence; emotional intelligence; intelligence test
commonMistake: intelligence 是名词，intelligent 是形容词；修饰名词应用 intelligent。

example.english: Artificial intelligence is used in many smart devices.
example.chinese: 人工智能被用于许多智能设备中。

application.prompt: The ability to learn and understand is called ___. A. intelligence B. intelligent
application.solution: A。解析：called 后需名词 intelligence；intelligent 是形容词。

grammar: n. 情绪智力，指识别、理解和调节情绪的能力，通常不可数。
collocations: emotional intelligence skills; develop emotional intelligence; emotional intelligence at work
commonMistake: 该词组以 intelligence 为中心词，通常不加 a；不要只把它理解成“感情上的智商分数”。

example.english: Good emotional intelligence helps people understand one another.
example.chinese: 良好的情绪智力有助于人们相互理解。

application.prompt: Understanding and managing feelings is part of ___. A. outer space B. emotional intelligence
application.solution: B。解析：理解和调节情绪的能力称 emotional intelligence。

grammar: v. 提到；写到。过去式/过去分词 mentioned。常用 mention sth to sb 或 mention that 从句。
collocations: mention a name; mention sth to a friend; mention that ...
commonMistake: mention 后直接接宾语，不说 mention about sth；要表达“向某人提到”用 mention sth to sb。

example.english: The researcher mentioned a new idea in her report.
example.chinese: 研究人员在报告中提到一个新想法。

application.prompt: Please ___ the meeting time to the team. A. mention about B. mention
application.solution: B。解析：mention 后直接接提及的内容，不加 about。

grammar: n. 冰箱，可数；常简称 fridge。
collocations: in the refrigerator; a refrigerator door; keep food in the fridge
commonMistake: refrigerator 是可数名词，单数前通常用 a/the；fridge 是常见非正式简称。

example.english: Keep the vegetables in the refrigerator to keep them fresh.
example.chinese: 把蔬菜放在冰箱里保鲜。

application.prompt: Milk should be kept cold in the ___. A. wallet B. refrigerator
application.solution: B。解析：用来冷藏牛奶的电器是 refrigerator（冰箱）。

grammar: adj. 低的；矮的；低水平的；adv. 向下、低；n. 低点。可用 low on 表示所剩不多。
collocations: a low price; a low voice; low on food
commonMistake: low 作形容词修饰名词，作副词修饰动作；注意 low 和 below（在……下面）意义不同。

example.english: The robot can fly low over the field.
example.chinese: 机器人可以在田野上方低空飞行。

application.prompt: The plane was flying close to the ground, at a ___ height. A. tall B. low
application.solution: B。解析：接近地面的高度是 low（低的）。

grammar: phr. （某物）即将用尽；快用完。常用 be running low on sth。
collocations: run low on fuel; run low on food; be running low on time
commonMistake: run low on 表示“所剩不多”；表示已经用完用 run out of，二者程度不同。

example.english: Our bus is running low on fuel, so we need to stop soon.
example.chinese: 我们的公交车燃料快用完了，所以需要尽快停下来。

application.prompt: We have only a little water left; we are ___ water. A. taking over B. running low on
application.solution: B。解析：所剩不多、快用完用 run low on。

grammar: v. 接受；相信（某个说法）。过去式/过去分词 accepted。
collocations: accept an invitation; accept an offer; accept that ...
commonMistake: accept 表示“接受”，except 表示“除……之外”；二者拼写近似但词性和含义不同。

example.english: She accepted the invitation to visit the robotics lab.
example.chinese: 她接受了参观机器人实验室的邀请。

application.prompt: He said yes to the invitation and decided to ___ it. A. accept B. except
application.solution: A。解析：表示同意并接受邀请用 accept。

grammar: n. 影响；作用，可数或不可数；v. 影响、对……起作用。
collocations: have an influence on; influence a decision; a positive influence
commonMistake: influence 作动词时直接接宾语，不说 influence on sb；名词结构是 have an influence on。

example.english: Technology can influence the way people learn.
example.chinese: 科技能够影响人们学习的方式。

application.prompt: Online videos can ___ what young people buy. A. disappear B. influence
application.solution: B。解析：表示对购买选择产生影响，用动词 influence。

grammar: adj. 有创造力的；创造性的。名词 creativity；副词 creatively。
collocations: a creative idea; creative writing; be creative
commonMistake: creative 是形容词，creativity 是名词；不要用名词直接修饰名词 idea。

example.english: The students found a creative way to reuse old computers.
example.chinese: 学生们想出了一个有创意的方法来再利用旧电脑。

application.prompt: The team designed an original and ___ solution. A. creative B. creativity
application.solution: A。解析：修饰名词 solution 需要形容词 creative。

grammar: adj. 不可能的。由 possible 加否定前缀 im- 构成。
collocations: it is impossible to do sth; impossible for sb; seem impossible
commonMistake: 常用 It is impossible to ...；impossible 拼写为 im-possible，不要漏写 m。

example.english: It is impossible to predict every change in technology.
example.chinese: 要预测科技领域的每一项变化是不可能的。

application.prompt: It is ___ to finish the task in one minute. A. possibility B. impossible
application.solution: B。解析：be 动词后作表语需用形容词 impossible。

grammar: n. 素质；质量；品质；adj. 优质的、高质量的（常作定语）。
collocations: high quality; quality education; the quality of a product
commonMistake: quality 作“品质、质量”时是名词；复数 qualities 常指人的特质。

example.english: The quality of the new school buses is very good.
example.chinese: 新校车的质量很好。

application.prompt: The ___ of the service improved after the changes. A. quality B. qualities
application.solution: A。解析：此处指服务的整体质量，用单数 quality。

grammar: v. 增强；发展；开发。过去式/过去分词 developed；名词 development。
collocations: develop skills; develop a system; develop into ...
commonMistake: develop 表示“发展、培养、开发”，宾语后不加 to；develop into 表示发展成为。

example.english: Students can develop useful skills by working on projects.
example.chinese: 学生可以通过参与项目培养有用的技能。

application.prompt: The club helps students ___ their problem-solving skills. A. develop B. development
application.solution: A。解析：help sb 后接动词原形，develop 是动词。

grammar: n. 德语；德国人；adj. 德国的。表示德国人时复数为 Germans。
collocations: speak German; a German student; German technology
commonMistake: German 首字母须大写；Germany 是国家“德国”，German 是德国的、德国人或德语。

example.english: Our German guest spoke about technology in her country.
example.chinese: 我们的德国客人谈到了她所在国家的科技。

application.prompt: The language spoken in Germany is ___. A. Germany B. German
application.solution: B。解析：German 可表示德语；Germany 是国家名称。

grammar: adj. 很有用的；宝贵的；有价值的。名词 value；复数名词 valuables 指贵重物品。
collocations: valuable information; valuable to sb; a valuable lesson
commonMistake: valuable 是形容词；名词为 value，复数名词 valuables 表示贵重物品。

example.english: The students received valuable advice from the researcher.
example.chinese: 学生们从研究人员那里得到了宝贵的建议。

application.prompt: The advice helped me a lot. It was very ___. A. valuable B. value
application.solution: A。解析：be 动词后用形容词 valuable 作表语。

grammar: adj. 公共的；公众的；n. the public 指公众。
collocations: public transport; public services; in public
commonMistake: public 作形容词时直接修饰名词；表示“在公共场合”说 in public，不说 in the public。

example.english: The city plans to improve public transport.
example.chinese: 这座城市计划改善公共交通。

application.prompt: People can use buses and trains as ___ transport. A. public B. publicly
application.solution: A。解析：修饰 transport 需要形容词 public。

grammar: adj. 医学的；医疗的。名词 medicine。
collocations: medical care; medical research; a medical student
commonMistake: medical 是形容词，medicine 是名词；医疗服务用 medical care，不用 medicine care。

example.english: The hospital uses new technology to provide medical care.
example.chinese: 这家医院使用新技术提供医疗服务。

application.prompt: The doctor gave the patient ___ help. A. medical B. medicine
application.solution: A。解析：修饰名词 help 应用形容词 medical。

grammar: n. 挑战；质疑；v. 向某人挑战；对……表示怀疑。
collocations: face a challenge; a challenge to sb; challenge an idea
commonMistake: challenge 作动词可直接接人或观点作宾语；形容“有挑战性的”用 challenging。

example.english: Building a safe robot is a challenge for the team.
example.chinese: 制造一台安全的机器人对团队来说是一项挑战。

application.prompt: The students must ___ the old idea and find better evidence. A. challenging B. challenge
application.solution: B。解析：must 后接动词原形，challenge 表示质疑。

grammar: n. 任务；工作，可数。
collocations: complete a task; a difficult task; a task for sb
commonMistake: task 是可数名词；表示“任务”时不要与 work（通常不可数）混淆。

example.english: Our first task is to design a robot that can help people.
example.chinese: 我们的首要任务是设计一台能帮助人们的机器人。

application.prompt: The students finished their science ___ before lunch. A. workes B. task
application.solution: B。解析：一项具体任务用可数名词 task。

grammar: v. 取决于；依靠。常用 depend on/upon；第三人称单数 depends。
collocations: depend on the weather; depend on sb; it depends
commonMistake: depend 后常接 on/upon；回答 “It depends.” 表示“看情况”。

example.english: Whether we travel by bus will depend on the weather.
example.chinese: 我们是否乘公交出行将取决于天气。

application.prompt: Our choice may ___ on the cost and time. A. depend B. depend of
application.solution: A。解析：depend 与 on 搭配，表示“取决于”。

grammar: phr. 取决于；依靠。后接名词、代词或动名词。
collocations: depend on a friend; depend on the result; depend on doing sth
commonMistake: 介词 on/upon 后接名词、代词或动名词；不能说 depend of。

example.english: Many future jobs may depend on new technology.
example.chinese: 未来的许多工作可能取决于新技术。

application.prompt: Success may ___ careful planning. A. depend of B. depend on
application.solution: B。解析：固定搭配为 depend on，表示“取决于”。

grammar: phr. 来访；拜访。常用 come over to sb's home/place；过去式 came over。
collocations: come over for dinner; come over to my house; have a friend come over
commonMistake: come over 表示来访；过去叙事时 come 变为 came，不要写 comed over。

example.english: My cousin will come over to see our new robot.
example.chinese: 我表弟将来我家看看我们的新机器人。

application.prompt: Would you like to ___ this afternoon and see the project? A. come over B. take over
application.solution: A。解析：邀请别人过来拜访用 come over。

grammar: conj. 只要；引导条件状语从句。
collocations: as long as you like; as long as we work together; as long as possible
commonMistake: as long as 表条件“只要”时后接完整从句；从句表将来时通常用一般现在时。

example.english: As long as we use energy carefully, we can help the environment.
example.chinese: 只要我们谨慎用能，就能帮助环境。

application.prompt: You can join the visit ___ you follow the safety rules. A. as long as B. even though
application.solution: A。解析：句意为“只要遵守安全规定就可以参加”，用 as long as 引导条件从句。
